status: discovery; one-project scope; existing cards/mods are behaviour baseline; browser session integration unresolved

verified_existing.core: Python library and CLI; repository Markdown records, hash-pinned links and append-only logs
verified_existing.owner_action: Mod offers pin displayed content; press checks session key, offer and current record hash. This is host-specific, not an existing browser authentication system.
verified_existing.mcp: read-only; does not provide browser mutation or agent lifecycle endpoints
verified_existing.capture_provenance: Current prompt absent from host log; captured without --prompt through supported CLI, quote unchecked and proposed.
verified_existing.mod_agent_followup: plugin/hooks/register.tsx ui.press calls iaso.press; uses prompt.fill for correction text, appends model_note to session as a user-type message, then refreshes snapshot. It does not spawn an independent repair agent in this handler. This code alone does not prove automatic turn scheduling.

proposals_not_decisions.ux: Prioritized issue inbox with focused resolution view, evidence/diff and linked agent activity; track human answer separately from repair and verified completion.
proposals_not_decisions.backend: Reuse Iaso Python core behind explicit read and owner-action APIs, with event updates and optional agent-runtime adapters; retain .iaso as authority. Choose runtime persistence and hosting after deployment scope is known.
proposals_not_decisions.agent_visibility: Show purpose, project/branch, current step, last activity, blocking issue and result; expose detailed events on demand. Do not invent completion percentages.
proposals_not_decisions.agent_integration: Browser companion to the relevant coding-agent session, reusing Iaso actions. Feasibility of attaching to an existing live session must be checked before selecting a host bridge.
